# Multiscale_Community_Detection

**Domain**: TCC
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted

## Definition
The identification of communities in a network at varying resolution parameters to reveal nested or hierarchical modular organization. It supplies the topological primitives needed for topology-centric computing and multiscale network analysis.
